notes: This matrix is a planning and execution baseline for ideal user paths.
It intentionally separates ideal-path coverage from frontend-console/e2e/scenario-coverage.md.
M7 is spec_only and remains future_matrix_only.

cases.trigger: POST /api/projects with empty title
cases.expected_resilience: returns 422 and creates no project row
cases.oracle: status_code == 422

cases.trigger: open a deleted project route or stale project handle
cases.expected_resilience: route falls back safely and stale data is not rendered as active
cases.oracle: user sees non-active project state or fallback view, not broken editor

cases.trigger: upload unsupported extension
cases.expected_resilience: returns 400 with clear error and does not parse content
cases.oracle: status_code == 400 and detail mentions unsupported type

cases.trigger: refresh or route switch immediately after import success
cases.expected_resilience: chapter tree and import history recover without duplicate import side effects
cases.oracle: import list remains single-source-of-truth and chapter tree renders imported chapters
cases.existing_coverage: import.spec.js covers success path but not recovery

cases.trigger: run deep import on a range, then submit same range again
cases.expected_resilience: second submission returns requires_confirmation instead of silently overwriting
cases.oracle: response.requires_confirmation == true

cases.trigger: submit async deep import, close page, reopen project
cases.expected_resilience: task progress or terminal state recovers from task API and does not disappear silently
cases.oracle: page shows recovered progress or terminal status derived from task result

cases.trigger: task result reaches done with degraded=true or quality_status=partial
cases.expected_resilience: client treats it as partial completion and surfaces warnings instead of full success only
cases.oracle: warning path is rendered and success state is not overstated

cases.trigger: save with stale expected_version after another version exists
cases.expected_resilience: returns 409 and preserves client-side input for manual recovery
cases.oracle: status_code == 409 and message indicates stale version

cases.trigger: refresh with unsaved editor content backed by localStorage
cases.expected_resilience: restore flow is visible and user content is recoverable without backend mutation
cases.oracle: restore prompt appears and editor content can be recovered

cases.trigger: create relation using source from novel A and target from novel B
cases.expected_resilience: request is rejected and no cross-novel edge is persisted
cases.oracle: status_code in [400, 404] and relation list remains empty

cases.trigger: open merge or rollback confirmation and cancel
cases.expected_resilience: dangerous action is not committed and list state stays unchanged
cases.oracle: entity status and list row count remain unchanged after cancel

cases.trigger: delete a scene then immediately re-read the deleted scene id
cases.expected_resilience: scene is not returned as active and ordered list remains coherent
cases.oracle: GET returns 404 and ordered list excludes the deleted scene as active
cases.existing_coverage: outline-scenes.spec.js covers delete path, not explicit stale reread

cases.trigger: delete or reorder scenes then navigate back to writing keepalive view
cases.expected_resilience: writing side panel and scene tree refresh to the new ordering or removal
cases.oracle: no stale scene card remains mounted after refresh boundary

cases.trigger: retrieve against an empty index
cases.expected_resilience: returns 200 with empty chunks and no server error
cases.oracle: status_code == 200 and total == 0

cases.trigger: query path degrades because embedding is unavailable
cases.expected_resilience: response sets degraded=true and exposes warnings instead of failing hard
cases.oracle: response.degraded == true and warnings length > 0

cases.trigger: compile with reveal_mode=character but no viewpoint_character_id
cases.expected_resilience: returns 400 with clear input error
cases.oracle: status_code == 400 and detail mentions viewpoint_character_id

cases.trigger: compile with invalid scope
cases.expected_resilience: returns 400 and does not run downstream loaders
cases.oracle: status_code == 400 and detail mentions invalid scope

cases.trigger: create same-layer duplicate map name
cases.expected_resilience: returns 409 and keeps existing config set unchanged
cases.oracle: status_code == 409

cases.trigger: create child map with parent_map_id from another novel
cases.expected_resilience: returns 404 and creates nothing
cases.oracle: status_code == 404

cases.trigger: bind non-location entity as location center
cases.expected_resilience: returns 400 and keeps bindings unchanged
cases.oracle: status_code == 400

cases.trigger: set a new center for the same location in quick succession
cases.expected_resilience: only one center remains after business clear_center logic
cases.oracle: state shows a single center tile for that location

cases.trigger: create child detail map with non-location parent_entity_id
cases.expected_resilience: returns 400 and prevents invalid hierarchy
cases.oracle: status_code == 400

cases.trigger: recent map points to a deleted map id
cases.expected_resilience: local recent state is cleared and workspace falls back to overview with visible warning
cases.oracle: toast and page message both show fallback explanation

cases.trigger: query scene-scoped markers with scene outside the visibility window
cases.expected_resilience: marker is hidden without crashing map state payload
cases.oracle: marker is absent for out-of-range scene and state payload remains valid

cases.trigger: switch scene, then clear current scene filter
cases.expected_resilience: scene bar, markers, and query params stay in sync
cases.oracle: scene bar resets and map remains browseable after clear

cases.trigger: paint territory hex outside map bounds
cases.expected_resilience: returns 400 and persists no invalid territory tile
cases.oracle: status_code == 400

cases.trigger: mutate marker or territory using another novel_id
cases.expected_resilience: returns 404 and leaves original novel state unchanged
cases.oracle: status_code == 404

cases.trigger: toggle focus mode after territory updates
cases.expected_resilience: focus response preserves non-territory fields and UI does not blank unrelated state
cases.oracle: focus payload includes map, tiles, markers, territories, and scene fields consistently

cases.trigger: AI suggests conflicting positions for the same entity in one scene
cases.expected_resilience: system stores suggestions for human review and does not write formal map state directly
cases.oracle: future contract must keep suggestions pending until confirmation
